# Data from 05-27-2026 and 05-28-2026

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=6, fig.align='center'}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
leaf_count <- read.csv("Stipa_salinity_experiment_data - survival_leaves_2026_05_27.csv") |> 
  clean_names() |> 
  select(
    water, 
    live_leaves,
    green_leaves, 
    salinity) |> 
  # Remove rows with missing values (NAs) to keep the graph clean
  drop_na(live_leaves, green_leaves) |> 
  # calculating proportion of live leaves 
  mutate(
    proportion_live = live_leaves / (live_leaves + green_leaves),
    salinity = as.factor(salinity)
  )

ggplot(leaf_count,
       mapping = aes(x = salinity,
                     y = proportion_live,
                     fill = water)) +
  # first layer: geom_boxplot
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5,
               position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
  # second layer: geom_jitter
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = water), # Color points by watering treatment too
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.8),
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 2,
    shape = 21
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of Live Leaves by Salinity and Water Treatment",
    x = "Salinity Treatment (dS/m)",
    y = "Proportion of Live Leaves",
    fill = "Watering Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  # Custom colors 
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("wet" = "skyblue3", "dry" = "darkkhaki")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("wet" = "skyblue3", "dry" = "darkkhaki")
  )
```

Dry treatment shown in yellow and wet in blue.
